Specification: This module specifies a very small consensus-style system in which a single state variable `chosen` starts as the empty set and can make one transition to a singleton set containing some value from the constant set `Value`. The safety side of the specification proves that `chosen` always remains a finite subset of `Value` with cardinality at most 1, using inductive invariance and cardinality axioms for the empty set and singleton sets. The liveness side adds weak fairness for `Next` and proves that if `Value` is nonempty then eventually some value is chosen, and also proves an equivalence characterizing the live specification in temporal logic. The module uses TLAPS proof constructs extensively and reasons explicitly about `ENABLED`, `WF_vars(Next)`, and leads-to properties.
